---
title: "Slides"
---

The course decks, rebuilt in **Typst** with a clean Beamer-*metropolis* look — fixed header/footer, incremental builds, native diagrams, and one worked idea per slide. Each **PDF** is the one-page-per-slide handout (present-mode builds are in the repo). Every deck carries `[Q]` question, `[V]` visual, `[D]` derivation, and `[I]` interactive tags, links to the [interactive explainers](https://nipunbatra.github.io/interactive-articles/), and machine-verified worked examples.

```{=html}
<div class="mod-head"><span class="mod-name">Module 1 · Foundations</span><span class="mod-ng">losses → models → calculus → backprop</span></div>
<div class="lec-list">
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">1</span><span><span class="lec-title">Why These Losses?</span><span class="lec-sub">a probabilistic view — distributions → likelihood → loss, priors → MAP → regularization</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L1.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">2</span><span><span class="lec-title">From Linear Models to Neural Networks</span><span class="lec-sub">linear &amp; logistic regression, neurons, MLPs, universal approximation</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L2.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">3</span><span><span class="lec-title">Calculus Toolkit</span><span class="lec-sub">derivatives, gradients, Jacobians &amp; Hessians — the geometry behind optimization</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L3A.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">4</span><span><span class="lec-title">Computation Graphs &amp; Backpropagation</span><span class="lec-sub">upstream × local, gradients accumulate — a fully worked graph + autodiff</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L3.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
</div>

<div class="mod-head"><span class="mod-name">Module 2 · Optimization &amp; Training</span><span class="mod-ng">use the gradients well</span></div>
<div class="lec-list">
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">5</span><span><span class="lec-title">Optimization for Deep Learning</span><span class="lec-sub">GD from Taylor, SGD as an unbiased estimator, momentum, Adam, LR schedules</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L5.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">6</span><span><span class="lec-title">Making Deep Networks Trainable</span><span class="lec-sub">initialization (Xavier / He), activations, batch / layer norm, residual connections</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L6.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">7</span><span><span class="lec-title">Generalization &amp; Regularization</span><span class="lec-sub">the gap, early stopping, weight decay / AdamW, dropout, augmentation, label smoothing</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L7.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
</div>

<div class="mod-head"><span class="mod-name">Module 3 · Computer Vision</span><span class="mod-ng">convolution → backbones → dense prediction</span></div>
<div class="lec-list">
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">8</span><span><span class="lec-title">Convolutional Neural Networks</span><span class="lec-sub">convolution, padding / stride, pooling, receptive fields, the CNN pipeline</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L8.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">9</span><span><span class="lec-title">Modern CNN Pipelines &amp; Transfer Learning</span><span class="lec-sub">VGG, 1×1 convs, Inception, ResNet, efficient CNNs, backbones &amp; fine-tuning</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L8B.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">10</span><span><span class="lec-title">Localization &amp; Object Detection</span><span class="lec-sub">boxes, IoU, anchors, focal loss, R-CNN family, YOLO, NMS</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L9.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">11</span><span><span class="lec-title">Semantic &amp; Instance Segmentation</span><span class="lec-sub">pixel cross-entropy, FCN, U-Net, Dice loss, Mask R-CNN</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L10.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
</div>

<div class="mod-head"><span class="mod-name">Module 4 · Sequences &amp; Language</span><span class="mod-ng">tokens → embeddings → next-token</span></div>
<div class="lec-list">
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">12</span><span><span class="lec-title">Next-Token Prediction</span><span class="lec-sub">sequence probability, tokenization, embeddings, the MLP language model (makemore), sampling</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L11.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">13</span><span><span class="lec-title">Sequence Models I — RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs</span><span class="lec-sub">recurrent state, backprop through time, vanishing gradients &amp; clipping, gated cells</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L12.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">14</span><span><span class="lec-title">Convolutional Sequence Models</span><span class="lec-sub">causal &amp; dilated convolutions, receptive fields, TCNs, WaveNet</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L13.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">15</span><span><span class="lec-title">Sequence Models II — Encoder–Decoder &amp; Attention</span><span class="lec-sub">seq2seq, teacher forcing, beam search, and attention over source states</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L14.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
</div>

<div class="mod-head"><span class="mod-name">Module 5 · Transformers</span><span class="mod-ng">attention is all you need</span></div>
<div class="lec-list">
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">16</span><span><span class="lec-title">Transformers I — Self-Attention</span><span class="lec-sub">scaled dot-product, causal masking, multi-head, positional encoding, the block</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L15.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
  <div class="lec"><span class="lec-num">17</span><span><span class="lec-title">Transformers II — BERT, GPT &amp; T5</span><span class="lec-sub">encoder/decoder/enc–decoder families, pretraining objectives, finetuning, decoding</span></span><span class="lec-links"><a href="slides-pdf/L16.pdf">PDF</a></span></div>
</div>
```
